faq.label: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.headline: What you need to know before starting.
faq.subtext: Answers to the most common questions about financing, collateral and process.

items.q: What types of financing do you offer?
items.a: Real estate and vehicle collateral loans, bridge financing and working capital, plus tailor-made capital structures: royalties, equity with buy-back options, mezzanine debt and co-investment.
We work mainly with real estate and vehicle assets, and evaluate other assets with real backing. Every guarantee is reviewed, structured and perfected as part of the transaction.

items.q: How do you evaluate each transaction?
items.a: Across four dimensions: LTV (loan-to-value) analysis, collateral evaluation, payment capacity and AML/CFT compliance. That analysis defines the structure and terms of each transaction.

items.q: Which sectors and companies do you work with?
items.a: Mining, small and medium businesses, real estate, productive projects and growth companies. Every business is evaluated on its fundamentals, not just its sector.

items.q: How fast can a transaction be structured?
items.a: It depends on the complexity and the documentation available. For opportunities that require an agile response we offer bridge financing, always after risk and collateral evaluation.
With a confidential conversation. We evaluate the business or opportunity and, if there is a fit, we propose the most suitable financing or investment structure.
